schema.title: Findings
schema.description: What a source, such as a vulnerability matcher, found in a manifest.

version.description: The version of the source's database.

matches.description: One entry for each vulnerability in each package. Empty when the source found nothing.

vulnerabilityID.description: The CVE where one exists, and else the ID of the advisory.

packageID.description: The ID of the package in the SBOM that the match was made from.

packageVersion.description: Left out for a package that has none.

severity.description: The source's own: such as Critical, High, Medium, Low, Negligible or Unknown.

fixState.description: The source's own: such as fixed, not-fixed, wont-fix or unknown. Empty when the source says nothing.

knownExploited.description: True when the source lists the vulnerability as known to be exploited.

version.description: The version of CVSS, such as 3.1.

operations.name: match
operations.description: Matches the packages of a manifest's SBOM, which the scanner's evidence holds, against the vulnerability database: the findings of the manifest, with severities, fixes, known exploitation and CVSS vectors.

parameterSchema.description: match takes no parameters: the scanner's evidence, which it is given as its input, is all it needs.

settingsSchema.description: How the matcher keeps its vulnerability database and how many SBOMs it matches at once. A setting that is left out takes its default.

updateIntervalSeconds.description: How often the database is updated. 21600 by default, which is 6 hours. It has no effect with databaseUpdates Offline.

maxConcurrent.description: How many SBOMs are matched at once: a match that finds them all busy waits for one. 2 by default, which is as many matches as the hub's assessor asks for at once.

databaseUpdates.description: Online updates the database, through the proxy of the collector's environment, when it has none and then every updateIntervalSeconds. Offline never updates it: the database is the one that is there, or the seed. Online by default.

seedDatabase.description: The absolute path of a directory that holds a database, such as the one that the image carries for a cluster without internet. At start, when the database directory holds no database, it is copied there before the database is loaded.
